intake_raw.project_description: Convert the attached garage into a small unit for a caregiver: one bedroom, a bathroom and a kitchenette, about 380 square feet. No addition and no change to the exterior other than replacing the garage door with a wall and a window, and the driveway keeps two parking spaces.

citations.quote: ADUs and JADUs shall have independent exterior access separate from the access to the primary dwelling.
The space has separate exterior access from the proposed or existing single-family dwelling.
It shall include permanent provisions for living, sleeping, eating, cooking, and sanitation on the same parcel where the existing or proposed primary dwelling is or will be situated.

finding_raw.rationale:
The applicant proposes to convert an attached garage into a 380-square-foot caregiver unit with one bedroom, a bathroom, and a kitchenette. Under Monrovia Municipal Code § 17.44.005(F)(5) and § 17.44.005(D)(1)(a)4, ADUs and JADUs must have independent exterior access separate from the primary dwelling. The application states that there will be "no change to the exterior other than replacing the garage door with a wall and a window," but does not clarify whether there is an existing independent exterior door or if one will be provided. Additionally, under § 17.44.005(C), an ADU must include "permanent provisions for living, sleeping, eating, cooking, and sanitation." The application mentions a "kitchenette" but does not provide details to confirm it includes permanent cooking facilities (such as appliances, a sink, food preparation counter, and food storage cabinets). Therefore, we must request the following information:
1. Clarification on whether the proposed unit has or will have independent exterior access separate from the primary dwelling.
2. Detailed specifications of the proposed kitchenette to ensure it meets the requirements for permanent cooking facilities.

citations.quote: ADUs and JADUs shall have independent exterior access separate from the access to the primary dwelling.
The space has separate exterior access from the proposed or existing single-family dwelling.
It shall include permanent provisions for living, sleeping, eating, cooking, and sanitation on the same parcel where the existing or proposed primary dwelling is or will be situated.
